description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The public reader surface remains the curated numbered-paper corpus: cumulative readers, standalone English paper PDFs, compact language/source packages, and scoped source-audit correction packets.

Pending local upload queue. After the latest public version, local staging adds RA37/RA40/RA41 for Paper 04, RA42 Paper 05, RA43-RA48 Paper 06 pp.161-196, Paper 03/Paper 11/Paper 12/Paper 13 GDZ source/provenance witness support, Paper 10/Paper 11/Paper 12 compact GDZ source-audit webdrops, Paper 06 GDZ remaining-source witness pp.173-196, targeted Paper 06/Paper 07/Paper 08 audit drops, Paper 14 source-audit results, Paper 15/Paper 16/Paper 17/Paper 18/Paper 19 source-audit fixes, targeted German cumulative candidates P16 RA53, P17 RA52, P18 RA51, P19 RA50, and P20 RA49, Paper 20 Lean/source-audit formula-fix material, German source-audit support companions, and a Slavic multilingual handoff through Papers 01-21 in Ukrainian, Russian, Interslavic Latin, and deterministic Interslavic Cyrillic. These pending files are not public Zenodo files until a token-backed upload/publish pass succeeds.

Slavic handoff caveat. The Slavic package is a translation/checkpoint handoff rather than an independent source-audit closure. Paper 22 is WIP only; the bundle carries provenance/tool material and raw audit/log warning history; and newer German source-audit fixes still need synchronization into those language branches.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, source/provenance witnesses, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. Paper 02 body pp.23-90 is closed at the RA29/RA30 page-level standard, Tabelle I p.91 is source-checked at RA31, and Tabelle II p.92 rows 0-23 are checked at plate-row level through RA33/RA34. RA41 reports Paper 04 pp.118-154 source-symbol closure at the current standard. RA48 reports Paper 06 pp.161-196 checked in a German source-critical candidate branch. Paper 03/Paper 11/Paper 12 standalone source-witness packages are provenance/witness support only; Paper 10/Paper 11/Paper 12 compact GDZ audit webdrops provide actionable patch targets and no-fix traps without applied cumulative TeX; Paper 13 has actionable audit findings plus the targeted P12/P13 RA48 candidate, but no full Paper 13 certification. The P16/P17/P18/P19/P20 candidates are targeted German repairs only and require branch reconciliation and non-German propagation before promotion. Final Paper 02 equation-tag/display-layout inventory, non-German propagation to EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH/UK/RU/ISV and the newer Slavic branches, and full symbol-level source audit beyond the checked tranches remain queued.
